idea.title: Kids' rangoli workshop before the competition
idea.description: A one-hour workshop the weekend before, so kids in each age group of the rangoli competition can practise their designs.

items.rationale: 150 kids and a rangoli competition by age group: practice helps the youngest.

idea.title: Diya-lit walkway for elderly residents
idea.description: Line the path from the lift lobby to the seating with diyas and handrail lights, with chairs along the way.

items.rationale: 90 elderly residents will walk to the terrace after dark.

idea.title: Sweets swap across traditions
idea.description: Each wing brings a Diwali sweet from its home state to a shared table, labelled with the state's name.

items.rationale: Residents come from many states; this shares their festival food.
